blocks.text: After speaking his “truth” on his past relationship with Jennylyn Mercado and their son Jazz, Patrick Garcia received support from his wife, Nikka Martinez, who described him as a “good man.” Martinez expressed her love for the actor through her Instagram Stories on Tuesday, Sept. 29. On the same day, Garcia’s tell-all interview with Ogie Diaz was shared on the latter’s YouTube channel. “I won in this life. I fell in love with a good man and I’ll never stop being grateful for that,” the quote card shared by Martinez read. “A self-made man. A hardworking man. A gentle man and […]...
